These Terms of Service apply to oixCloud websites, accounts, subscriptions, network access, and related products and services. Read them fully before registering, paying, or using a service.



Parties and Scope

The principal terms in this Agreement are defined as follows:

 'oixCloud,' 'we,' 'us,' and 'our' mean the oixCloud operator providing the relevant product or service. 'Website' includes websites and customer interfaces operated by us that link to these Terms.
 'You' and 'Customer': Mean the person or entity that registers, purchases, accesses, or uses a Service and its authorized end users. Anyone accepting these Terms for an entity confirms that they have authority to bind it.

By creating an account, paying for, accessing, or continuing to use any oixCloud product or service, you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted these Terms. If you do not agree, do not register, purchase, or use the Services, and disable recurring billing.

Incorporated Documents

These Terms, the Acceptable Use Policy, Privacy Policy, Service Level Agreement, product pages, order pages, and specific conditions shown at purchase form the Agreement. If they conflict, specific purchase conditions and these Terms control, subject to non-waivable law.

All language versions are intended to express the same terms. If an ambiguity cannot be reconciled, the Simplified Chinese version governs interpretation, without changing specific conditions expressly stated at purchase or limiting non-waivable rights under applicable law.

IN SHORT:

Using or buying a Service means accepting these Terms and the policies they reference.

1. Accounts and Services

1.1    You must have legal capacity to contract under applicable law, provide complete and accurate information, and keep your email address and other essential contact information current.

1.2    Only authorized persons may use an account, subject to the restrictions on account sharing. Authorized use is limited to what the product expressly permits; permission given by an account holder does not override sharing, resale or personal-plan restrictions. You must protect login passwords, subscription links, client tokens, node credentials and related devices, and are responsible for authorized users. Suspected unauthorized activity will not be attributed to you personally solely because it occurred under your account.

If you discover or reasonably suspect that an account, subscription or other credential has been exposed, promptly reset or revoke affected credentials using available account functions, report the time, affected Services and steps taken through a support ticket, and reasonably cooperate with the review. Do not include passwords, complete subscription links, tokens or private keys in a ticket.

We review abnormal activity and responsibility using records actually held and information supplied by both parties, distinguishing voluntary sharing, third-party misuse and problems with our own Services. An appeal does not automatically restore traffic, reverse valid charges or create refund eligibility. Actual resource use after account compromise is not automatically a billing error; billing anomalies are reviewed under the Fees section.

Use a Website support ticket for appeals where possible. If an account is compromised or you cannot sign in, email [email redacted] with the account email, incident details and necessary non-secret information. We may require reasonable identity verification and will not ask for passwords, complete subscription links, tokens or private keys. We will explain any additional information needed and the next steps for complex cases, without promising a fixed resolution time.

1.3    Services are generally delivered digitally after payment confirmation. Client software, devices, operating systems, app-store fees, and third-party software are not included unless expressly stated.

1.4    For security, compliance, maintenance, capacity, or product improvement, we may change nodes, routes, protocols, addresses, configurations, or features and may substitute comparable resources.

1.5    We do not guarantee that any particular website, application, regional content, streaming service, route, IP address, latency, bandwidth, or third-party service will remain available or compatible.

1.6    Except for non-waivable rights under applicable law, successful payments are final and generally non-refundable. We do not provide cash redemption, return to the original payment method or withdrawal of account balances. Non-use, non-activation, mistaken or duplicate purchases made by the user, unmet expectations, compatibility issues, network differences, third-party restrictions, account suspension or termination, expiry and service interruption are not grounds for a refund or compensation. Billing anomalies are reviewed under the Fees section without making correctly billed transactions refundable. Additional goodwill arrangements create no continuing obligation or precedent.

1.7    Subscription periods, traffic, and benefits are calculated as shown on the order page. Unused amounts expire and do not roll over unless expressly stated. A subscription without recurring billing ends at expiry. If recurring billing is enabled, it is charged for each selected term until disabled before the next charge.

1.8   Only inactive accounts without an active plan or pending benefits are eligible for cleanup. The period is 30 days if both balance and commission are zero or negative, or 365 days if either is positive, starting from the later of the last login activity and the expiry of an already expired plan. Signing in on the website or a client, or making authenticated requests while signed in, restarts the period. The system normally schedules warnings 7, 3 and 1 days before expected deletion. Delivery depends on contact details and delivery channels; keep your contact information current and sign in before the deadline to retain the account. Deletion removes the balance and commission. Active or queued plans, deposits awaiting return and other pending benefits prevent automatic cleanup under the existing rules.

1.9   Exclusive IPs have separate billing and rental periods, with each billed month fixed at 30 days. Buying, renewing and using an IP requires a currently active plan; activate queued plans first. The IP rental period may extend beyond the plan expiry. If the plan expires, use is paused and the IP is reserved until its own expiry; its rental period is not paused or extended. Restore a plan to use an IP that has not expired. The auto-renewal switch records your preference. Within 24 hours before expiry, renewal is attempted if the plan is active, funds are sufficient and the node is operational. Otherwise no charge is made and the setting is kept; IPs not renewed by expiry are handled under the reclamation rules.

1.10   An exclusive IP may only be used by the purchasing account. Some exclusive IP products require a separate deposit for each IP, as shown in the purchase window, to guarantee that the IP is not abused; a deposit below the product requirement is topped up with the renewal. No deposit is charged on a purchase or renewal of 6 months or more at once, while any deposit already paid stays held. Once the same IP has 12 months paid in total, counting new purchases and manual and automatic renewals, no deposit is needed at all, and any deposit already paid goes toward the renewal that reaches 12 months, with any amount above the rent returned to the account balance. If reasonable evidence establishes abuse of the IP during the holding period in breach of the Acceptable Use Policy, including but not limited to spam, port scanning, attacks and copyright infringement, and responsibility is attributable to the purchaser or an authorized user, following the checks below, the whole deposit is forfeited and not returned, and later renewals collect it again under the rules above. Where no deposit was paid or it has already been forfeited, the purchaser bears upstream provider or network operator handling fees verified as resulting from that abuse and supported by a charging basis, deducted from account balance and commission; if this leaves the balance negative, the account may be suspended for arrears until it is topped up. We may also restrict or terminate the related services under the Acceptable Use Policy. 14 days after the IP stops being renewed and is released, a deposit that was not forfeited is returned in full to the account balance automatically. Returned deposits cannot be withdrawn or returned to the original payment method and can only be spent on the service. The account cannot be deleted before the deposit is returned.

1.11   Before forfeiting a deposit or charging abuse fees, we will check the complaint time and time zone, IP allocation and holding records, and other available evidence. At or promptly after the deduction, we will arrange notice of the incident, grounds, charge items and amounts. Upstream handling fees will also include the charging basis and calculation, excluding information subject to legal confidentiality or third-party privacy. Users may appeal through a support ticket. We will review the case and reverse incorrect action and correct erroneous deductions if attribution is wrong or the grounds are insufficient. Receipt of a complaint alone is not grounds for a deduction; urgent risks may first be temporarily restricted under the Acceptable Use Policy.

1.12   Repeated complaints about the same abuse incident do not result in repeated deposit forfeiture or collection of the same handling fee. If a deposit has been forfeited for an incident, no additional upstream handling fee is charged for that incident. Otherwise, only verified, supported upstream handling fees actually incurred are charged once. Separate incidents are reviewed separately, with charge items and amounts explained. Users may request review and correction of duplicate charges or mistaken attribution.

Plan auto-renewal depends on available funds, plan status and applicable rules. Turning it off forfeits the renewal price and cannot be undone; read the confirmation first.

IN SHORT:

Services are digitally delivered; the order and product pages define what is included.

Protect login passwords, subscription links, tokens and node credentials. Reset and report exposed credentials promptly.

Payments are generally non-refundable and account balances cannot be withdrawn. Check the plan, term, amount and compatibility before ordering.

2. Acceptable Use and Resource Management
2.1
Security and Lawful Use

You must not use the Services for unlawful, infringing, fraudulent, destructive, or unauthorized activity, including:

Unauthorized access or attempted access to any account, data, device, system, or network.
Interference, stress testing, denial-of-service activity, or other harm to a user, host, network, or service.
Distribution of malware, ransomware, Trojans, viruses, botnets, phishing pages, or harmful code.
Circumvention of authentication, access controls, usage limits, security measures, or technical protections.
Using the Services to compromise third-party systems, steal credentials, conceal an attack source, or assist abuse.
Storing, accessing, or distributing unlawful, infringing, exploitative, abusive, or seriously harmful content.
Fraud, money laundering, unlawful transactions, sanctions evasion, or other activity prohibited by applicable law.

We do not inspect all communications merely by providing the Services. We may process technical data, restrict access, preserve evidence, and disclose information where reasonably necessary for security, abuse investigation, enforcement, or legal compliance.

2.2
Traffic and Quotas

Platform records govern usage. Reaching a traffic, connection, speed, or other limit may result in throttling, suspension, or a requirement to purchase additional resources. Unused quotas do not roll over unless expressly stated.

2.3
Fair Use

Shared infrastructure must be used reasonably. If activity threatens security, stability, or other users, we may limit connections, traffic, processes, or features. Prohibited uses include:

Lending, sharing, pooling, sublicensing, or reselling accounts, subscription links, or Services unless expressly permitted.
Unauthorized P2P or BitTorrent use, copyright infringement, or sustained downloads that consume abnormal shared resources.
Unauthorized crawlers, port scans, vulnerability probes, bulk registrations, automated requests, or packet-generation tasks.
Spam, unsolicited bulk messages, or maintaining address lists for such messages.

IN SHORT:

To protect shared systems, we may throttle or suspend abnormal resource consumption.

Do not attack, probe, or damage our systems or any third-party system.

The Acceptable Use Policy contains the full restrictions.

3. Spam and Abuse

3.1    Using the Services to send or facilitate spam, unsolicited bulk messages, phishing, or deceptive promotions is prohibited. We may immediately restrict or terminate related accounts and Services.

3.2    We may address suspected abuse using complaints, bounces, automated signals, third-party reports and investigation results, and may request authorization or information needed to locate an incident. A complaint alone does not establish a violation. Investigation, temporary restrictions and review follow the Acceptable Use Policy, which forms part of these Terms.

IN SHORT:

Spam and abuse may result in immediate suspension without a refund.

4. Fees, Billing, and No Refunds

The price, currency, term, taxes and payment methods are those shown when an order is submitted. You authorize us or our payment provider to process the selected payment. Except where mandatory law requires otherwise, correctly billed transactions are non-refundable and account balances cannot be withdrawn; interruption, performance variation or termination creates no refund or compensation. Submit a ticket about anomalous billing records. Verified billing errors will be corrected, and account balances remain non-withdrawable. Mistaken or duplicate purchases made by the user and dissatisfaction with the service are not billing errors. Expressly offered functions such as returning a plan to account balance follow the rules shown at that entry point.

Where plan management explicitly offers a return of an unused plan to balance, its eligibility and amount apply. This is an internal balance adjustment, not a refund to the payment method or a balance withdrawal. Eligible commission withdrawals follow the referral program rules.

IN SHORT:

The order price and term are shown before you confirm payment.

Correctly billed transactions are non-refundable and account balances cannot be withdrawn. Billing anomalies may be submitted for review.

5. Changes to Terms and Services

We may update these Terms, related policies, Service content, and future pricing in response to legal, regulatory, security, operational, or product changes.

5.1    An updated version will be posted with a revision date. Where reasonably practicable, material changes affecting your rights will also be highlighted through the Website, account, or email. Urgent security, legal, or abuse-prevention changes may take effect immediately.

5.2    Continued use after a change takes effect means acceptance. If you disagree, stop using the Services and disable future renewals. Amounts already paid remain subject to the no-refund policy.

IN SHORT:

These Terms may change as the Services and legal requirements evolve.

Review the current version before purchasing, renewing, or continuing to use a Service.

6. Other Legal Terms
6.1
Force Majeure

We are not liable for delay or interruption caused by natural disaster, war, government action, carrier or supplier failure, Internet disruption, power failure, attack, labor event, or another event beyond our reasonable control.

6.2
Disclaimers and Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Services are provided 'as is' and 'as available.' We are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, punitive, or consequential loss. Our aggregate liability is limited to the amount you actually paid for the affected Service during the three months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

6.3
Dispute Resolution

The parties will first try in good faith to resolve a dispute through a support ticket. Any unresolved dispute will be handled under applicable law by an authority with jurisdiction. This clause does not limit non-waivable consumer rights.

6.4
Severability and No Waiver

If any provision is invalid, the remaining provisions continue in effect. A delay in exercising a right is not a waiver of that right.

6.5
Assignment

You may not transfer an account or this Agreement without our written consent. We may transfer this Agreement as part of a reorganization, merger, asset transfer, or Service migration, subject to any legally required notice.

6.6
Notices and Contact

We may give notice through the Website, account messages, or your registered email. Questions, complaints, and legal notices may be submitted through a Website support ticket, and you must keep your contact details current.

IN SHORT:

Events outside reasonable control may affect service and create no refund or compensation.

Liability limits apply only to the extent permitted by applicable law.

Submit a support ticket first if a dispute arises.
